name: torchtitan v0.4.0 with PyTorch 2.15.0 in a uv venv (shared with the FlexShard investigation)

tasks.name: clone torchtitan at the release tag and check the commit
uv venv: torch 2.15.0 from the cu132 index (the only CUDA build of 2.15.0), then torchtitan editable
commands: command -v uv || (curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | env UV_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/local/bin sh)

DRV=$(nvidia-smi | grep -oE 'CUDA Version: [0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9.]+$'); python3 -c "import sys; v=tuple(map(int,'$DRV'.split('.'))); sys.exit(0 if v>=(13,2) else 1)" || { echo "torch $TORCH_VERSION is published for CUDA 13.2 only; this driver supports CUDA $DRV"; exit 1; }; IDX=https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu132; echo "driver-cuda=$DRV index=$IDX" | tee $OUT/torch-index.txt
$VENV/bin/python -c 'import torch, torchtitan, torch_checkpointing; print(torch.__version__, torch.version.cuda, torch.cuda.device_count())' | tee $OUT/imports.txt

tasks.name: every checkpoint recipe resolves (print the config, no GPUs used)
commands: cd $TORCHTITAN_SRC && for R in ckpt_dcp_sync ckpt_dcp_async ckpt_dcp_async_pinned ckpt_torch_checkpointing; do PYTHONPATH=$INVESTIGATION_DIR/scripts $VENV/bin/python -m torchtitan.train --module ckpt_recipes --config $R --print-config > $OUT/print-config-$R.txt 2>&1 || { tail -20 $OUT/print-config-$R.txt; exit 1; }; grep -iE 'async_mode|interval|TorchCheckpointing' $OUT/print-config-$R.txt | head -3; done

tasks.name: the 8B checkpoint recipe trains 3 steps on 8 GPUs before anything is timed
commands: cd $TORCHTITAN_SRC && PATH=$VENV/bin:$PATH NGPU=8 MODULE=ckpt_recipes CONFIG=ckpt_dcp_sync PYTHONPATH=$INVESTIGATION_DIR/scripts CKPT_STEPS=3 ./run_train.sh --output-dir /tmp/titan-smoke 2>&1 | tail -40 | tee $OUT/smoke.txt
